title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 12 discussion

opinions.point: The episode was widely viewed as entertaining, blending horror, comedy, folklore, and character-focused moments effectively.
Several commenters especially enjoyed Dara-san and the sibling interactions, describing the character dynamics as a highlight.
Many readers were enthusiastic about the show overall and disappointed that only one episode remained.
The ending generated strong excitement and curiosity, but some viewers felt the sudden escalation made the episode more alarming than expected.
A few reactions expressed frustration with the threatening late-episode development and uncertainty about how the characters would resolve it.

notes: The title explicitly names Reiwa no Dara-san and episode 12. Reddit exposed the thread and comment text, but the displayed score was unavailable, so score is reported as 0; the comment count is based on the thread view. Opinions are paraphrased and spoiler-free.
